page.about.title: About {siteName}
page.about.body1: {siteName} is a warm, passionate destination for anyone who loves the piano — beginners just starting out, active learners refining their technique, and lifelong enthusiasts who adore the instrument's history and culture. We cover all musical genres equally: classical, jazz, pop, and contemporary.
page.about.body2: Our content spans five pillars in balance: the instrument's rich history and cultural stories, practical learning and technique tips, coverage of modern developments, sheet music and practice resources, and gear reviews covering acoustic, digital, and hybrid pianos. We believe the piano belongs to everyone, and our writing reflects that — heartfelt and inviting rather than academic or gatekeeping.
page.about.body3: Whether you've just discovered a love for piano or you've been playing for decades, you'll find something here worth reading. We're building a global home for piano lovers, and we're glad you're here.
page.about.seoTitle: About PianoEd — Our Mission, Vision & Values
page.about.seoDescription: Discover the mission, vision, and values behind PianoEd — the world's home for piano lovers. Learn what drives us to make piano education, culture, and inspiration freely accessible to every player.

page.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
page.faq.subtitle: Can't find what you're looking for?
page.faq.q1.question: What is this site about?
page.faq.q1.answer: This site provides articles, tools, and resources to help you explore, learn, and enjoy the piano — whether you're a beginner, active learner, or lifelong enthusiast.
page.faq.q2.question: Do I need to create an account?
page.faq.q2.answer: No. All articles, tools, and resources are free to access without registration. You may optionally subscribe to our newsletter for updates.
page.faq.q3.question: How often is new content published?
page.faq.q3.answer: We publish new articles and resources regularly. Subscribe to our newsletter or RSS feed to get notified when new content goes live.
page.faq.q4.question: Can I contribute an article?
page.faq.q4.answer: Yes! We welcome guest contributions. Please reach out via our contact page with your topic idea and a brief outline.
page.faq.q5.question: Are the tools free to use?
page.faq.q5.answer: Yes, all interactive tools on this site are completely free. No signup, no paywall, no data collection.
page.faq.q6.question: Does this site work on mobile?
page.faq.q6.answer: Absolutely. The entire site is responsive and optimized for mobile devices, including all tools and interactive features.
page.faq.seoDescription: Find answers to common questions about our site, content, tools, and how to get the most out of your visit.

page.about.hero.title: A Global Home for Piano Lovers
page.about.hero.subtitle: {siteName} was founded on a single, enduring conviction: that the piano is one of humanity's greatest inventions, and that its stories, music, and lessons deserve a home as extraordinary as the instrument itself.
page.about.mission.quote: “To make exceptional piano education, culture, and inspiration freely accessible to every player in the world — regardless of age, genre, or experience.”
page.about.mission.body1: {siteName} exists to bridge the gap between the vast, scattered world of piano knowledge and the players who need it most. We bring together historians, educators, performers, and enthusiasts to produce content that is simultaneously deep and accessible — content that respects the intelligence of our readers without losing the warmth that makes learning music a joy.
page.about.mission.body2: We publish for the full spectrum of the piano community: the eight-year-old playing “Twinkle Twinkle” for the first time, the conservatoire student navigating the Rach Three, the retired accountant who finally has time to learn, and the professional concert artist seeking new perspectives. Every reader matters equally to us.
page.about.mission.body3: Our mission is not merely to inform — it is to inspire. We want readers to close a {siteName} article and immediately feel compelled to sit down at their piano. That spark of motivation, that renewed sense of purpose, is the truest measure of our success.
page.about.vision.title: Where We're Going
page.about.vision.body1: We envision {siteName} as the world's most trusted and beloved online destination for piano — the place that comes to mind first when anyone, anywhere, wants to learn something new about the instrument, discover a piece of music, or find community with fellow pianists.
page.about.vision.body2: In the near term, we are building out five interconnected content pillars that cover every dimension of the piano experience. In the medium term, we will expand our interactive learning tools, curated sheet music library, and multilingual content to serve players across the globe. In the long term, we aim to foster a self-sustaining community of contributors and educators who collectively raise the quality of piano education worldwide.
page.about.vision.body3: We believe the internet has never produced a truly great piano publication — one with the editorial rigour of a respected music journal, the warmth of a great teacher, and the reach of a modern digital platform. Building that publication is our north star.
page.about.pillars.title: Five Pillars of Piano
page.about.pillars.subtitle: Our content is organised around five equally-weighted pillars that together span the full breadth of the piano world.
page.about.pillars.p1.title: History & Culture
page.about.pillars.p1.desc: From the earliest fortepianos of the Baroque era to the concert grands of today, we explore the rich stories, composers, and cultural milestones that shaped the piano's extraordinary journey through history.
page.about.pillars.p2.title: Learning & Technique
page.about.pillars.p2.desc: Practical, accessible guidance for every stage of the learning journey — from first-time hand placement and sight-reading basics to advanced pedalling, articulation, and interpretation techniques.
page.about.pillars.p3.title: Modern Developments
page.about.pillars.p3.desc: Interviews with contemporary pianists, reviews of recent recordings, coverage of competitions and premieres, and a watchful eye on how technology is reshaping the world of piano.
page.about.pillars.p4.title: Sheet Music & Practice Resources
page.about.pillars.p4.desc: A growing library of curated sheet music, practice exercises, and study guides — carefully organised by level, genre, and composer — so learners always have something meaningful to work on.
page.about.pillars.p5.title: Gear & Instruments
page.about.pillars.p5.desc: Honest, in-depth reviews of acoustic uprights, baby grands, concert grands, digital pianos, and hybrid instruments — helping players at every budget make informed decisions.
page.about.values.title: What We Believe
page.about.values.v1.title: The Piano Belongs to Everyone
page.about.values.v1.body: We firmly reject the gatekeeping that has surrounded classical music for generations. Whether you play by ear, read music fluently, study with a teacher, or teach yourself from YouTube, you belong here.
page.about.values.v2.title: All Genres Deserve Equal Celebration
page.about.values.v2.body: Bach and Beethoven share these pages with Bill Evans, Chick Corea, Elton John, and Yiruma. The piano's voice is universal — we honour it in every idiom.
page.about.values.v3.title: Learning Is a Lifelong Journey
page.about.values.v3.body: We write for the curious beginner, the intermediate player hitting a plateau, the returning adult learner, and the seasoned professional who never stops growing. Progress, not perfection, is our compass.
page.about.values.v4.title: Quality Over Quantity
page.about.values.v4.body: Every article, guide, and review published on {siteName} is crafted to genuinely serve the reader. We would rather publish one excellent piece than ten forgettable ones.
page.about.values.v5.title: Community Over Competition
page.about.values.v5.body: The piano community is warm, encouraging, and generous. We strive to reflect those same values in everything we publish — celebrating the achievements of players and creators at every level.
page.about.community.title: Our Community
page.about.community.body1: Our readers span every age, skill level, and musical background. They include children taking their first lessons, teenagers preparing for conservatoire auditions, adults returning to the piano after decades away, and professional pianists seeking fresh perspectives on their craft. They live in Lagos and London, Mumbai and Montreal, Seoul and São Paulo.
page.about.community.body2: What unites them is simple: a love for the piano. Some are drawn to the discipline and structure of classical repertoire. Others prefer the improvisation and soul of jazz. Many enjoy the nostalgic pleasure of playing pop songs and film scores. All of them deserve a publication that speaks to them honestly, warmly, and with genuine expertise.
page.about.community.body3: {siteName} is also built for the teachers, scholars, and music therapists who work with piano every day — professionals who need a reliable reference, fresh inspiration for their students, and a wider community of practice to connect with.
page.about.cta.title: Your Life in Music Starts Here
page.about.cta.subtitle: Whether you're rediscovering a childhood instrument, just beginning your journey, or a seasoned performer seeking new ideas — we are glad you found us. Explore, learn, and let the music move you.
